findings: The isometric view shows the green native PCB substrate, dense component arrays, four distinct upper rings, and lower supports.
The front view shows components on both PCB faces and a visible gap from the board components to the eight support rings.
The grey material is uniform because the native component STL does not retain the source GLB material groups.
